item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 25/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The weather will be cooler over the region tomorrow. It will be windier in the following couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to cross the coast of Guangdong over the weekend, and bringing showers and thunderstorms to the region. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, temperatures will rise gradually midweek next week.
